spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पलति)
To go, to move.

n. (-लं)
1 A weight of gold or silver equal to four Karṣas or Suvarṇas; also of four or of eight Tolas, or in common use, of three Tolas, two Māṣas, and eight

Rattis.
2

A moment, the sixtieth part of an Indian hour.
3 Flesh.
m. (-लः)
Straw after threshing, &c.
E.
पल to go, to move, aff. अप्.

r. 1st cl. (पल्लति)
To go.

m. (-ल्लः)
A large basket, or matted shed used for keeping corn, &c.
f. (-ल्ली)
1 A small village.
2 A city, or rather an affix to words forming the name of a town; it is especially used in the Dekhin, as in Trichinopoly or Trisira-pallī, &c.
3 A small house lizard.
4 A creeping plant.
E.
पल्ल to go, aff. अच्; also with इन् aff. पल्लि.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (पालयति)
To guard, to preserve or protect.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Who or what guards or preserves.
m. (-लः)
1 A nourisher, a protector.
2 A spitting pot.
f. (-ली)
1 The sharp edge of a sword.
2 A woman with a beard.
3 A louse.
4 A line, a row or range.
5 A pot, a boiler.
E.
पाल to nourish, aff. अच्; ङीष् added; also with इ aff. पालि.

m. (-रः)
Blood.
E.
पल flesh, and क्षार what oozes.

m. (-ण्डः)
A bricklayer, a plasterer.
E.
पल flesh or mortar, compared to it, and गण्ड a mark or spot.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Timid, fearful, frightened.
E.
पल flesh, कट to go, aff. खच्; whose flesh shrinks with fear.

m. (-रः)
Bile.
E.
पल flesh, कर what makes.

m. (-षः)
1 A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin.
mf. (-षः-षा)
The Bdellium tree.
f. (-षा)
1 A plant, (Ruellia longifolia.)
2 The ichneumon plant: see रास्ना.
3 The Palāśa tree, (Butea frondosa.)
4 Lac, the animal dye.
5 A creeper: see मुण्डीरी.
E.
पल flesh, and कष what injures, aff. खच्.

f. (-भा)
The mid-day shadow of a gnomon, when the sun is in the equinoctial points.

m. (-वः)
A snare or basket of wicker work for catching fish.
E.
पल flesh, and वा to get, aff. क.

mn. (-वः-वं)
1 A sprout, a shoot, the extremity of a branch bearing new leaves.
2 A branch.
3 Spreading, expansion.
4 A wood.
5 The red dye of lac.
6 Love, the sentiment or passion.
7 A catamite.
8 A bracelet.
9 Unsteadiness, moral or physical.
E.
पद् the foot, लू to cut or break, अप् aff.

Flesh.
2

Mud, mire, clay.
3 Oil-cake or sesamum seed.
m. (-लः)
A Rākṣasa, a goblin or imp.
E.
पल to go, Uṇādi aff. कलच्; or पल flesh, and ला to get, aff. क.

mn. (-लः-लं)
Straw.
E.
पल to go, Uṇādi aff. कालन्.

m. (-रः)
Bile.
E.
पलल flesh, ज्वर heat.

m. (-यः)
A raven.
E.
पलल, and प्रिय fond of.

m. (-यः)
Swelled neck, bronchocele.
E.
पलल flesh, आशय asylum.

m. (-ग्निः)
Bile, the bilious humour.
E.
पल flesh, अग्नि fire.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The Gangetic porpoise.
E.
पल flesh, गम to go or get, aff. ड.

m. (-ण्डुः)
An onion.
E.
पल to preserve, (from disease,) अण्डु aff.

mf. (-दः-दा)
A Rākṣasa, male or female.
E.
पल flesh, अद who eats; also पलादन mf. (-नः-नी.)

m. (-पः)
1 A halter.
2 An elephant's temples.

f. (-हा)
A collyrium: see कुलत्था.

n. (-नं)
Flight, retreat.
E.
परा from, अयन going, र changed to ल.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Running away.
E.
परा before अच् to go, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Fugitive.
E.
पलायन, and परायण addicted to.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Defeated, flown, run away, retreated.
E.
पलायन flying, इतच् aff., or पल to go, aff. क्त, in the causal form.

m. (-दः)
The mango tree.
E.
पलाल straw, दोहद wishing, requiring straw for manure, or from the fruit being sometimes ripened in straw.

Green.
2

Unfeeling, unmerciful, cruel.
n. (-शं)
A leaf.
m. (-शः)
1 A tree bearing red blossoms, (Butea frondosa.)
2 A demon, a goblin.
3 A sort of Curcuma, (C. reclinata, Rox.)
4 Ancient Behār or Magadhā.
f. (शी)
1

Lac.
2

A kind of creeper.
E.
पल going, or flesh, अश to spread, to eat, &c. aff. अण् or अच्.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
1 Of a green colour.
2 Belonging to the Palāśa tree, made of its wood, &c.
m. (-शः)
Green, (the colour.)
E.
पलाश a leaf, or the tree, aff. अञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 Curcuma reclinata.
2 The Pala's tree.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-ख्यः)
Asafœtida.

f. (-म्भा)
Ajwaen: see गन्धपदा.

m. (-शी)
1 A tree in general.
2 A goblin.
3 A sort of Mimusops, (M. kauki, Rox.)
E.
पलाश a leaf, इनि aff.

f. (-क्नी)
1 An old or greyheaded woman.
2 A cow with calf.
E.
पलित grey hair, aff. ङीप्, and क्न substituted for तः see पलित.

m. (-घः)
1 A glass vessel.
2 A water pot.
3 The gate way of a building.
4 A wall.
E.
परि completely, हन to injure, घ substituted for the radical, and र changed to लः see परिघ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-क्नी-तं)
Greyhaired, old.
m. (-तः)
An old man.
f. (-ता)
An old woman.
n. (-तं)
1 Greyness of the hair.
2 Much or ornamented hair.
3 Heat, burning.
4 Mud, mire.
5 Benzoin.
E.
पल to go, (towards death,) Uṇādi aff. क्त, or पल flesh, &c. and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cherished, nourished.
m. (-तः)
The Śākhoṭa tree.
E.
पाल to nourish, aff. क्त.

m. (-ङ्कः)
A bedstead.
E.
see पर्य्यङ्क, र being changed to ल.

n. (-नः)
A saddle, a pack-saddle.
E.
परि before अयन going, र changed to ल.

r. 10th cl. (पल्युलयति)
1 To cut.
2 To purify; also written पल्युल्ल and पल्यूल, &c.

r. 10th cl. (पल्यूलयति)
1 To cut.
2 To purify; also पल्युल and पल्युल्ल.

m. (-कः)
1 The paramour of a harlot.
2 A kind of fish, (Cyprinus denticulatus.)
3 A catamite.
E.
पल्लव love, and कन् aff.

m. (-द्रुः)
The Asoka tree.
E.
पल्लव, and द्रु a tree.

m. (-दः)
A deer.
E.
पल्लव a shoot, अद to eat, aff. अच्.

m. (-रः)
A branch.
E.
पल्लव a sprout, and आधार receptacle.

m. (-स्त्रः)
KĀMADEVA.
E.
पल्लव a sprout or blossom, and अस्र a weapon.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Amorous, desirous.
E.
पल्लव passion, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Having new sprouts.
2 Spread, extended.
m. (-तः)
The red dye of the lac insect.
E.
पल्लव a sprout, &c. इतच् aff.

m. (-वी)
A tree.
E.
पल्लव a sprout, aff. इनि.

f. (-ल्लिः)
1 A small village.
2 Any village.
3 A house.
4 A number of houses.
5 Any place or station.
6 A house lizard: see पल्ल and पल्ली.

f. (-लिः)
1 The sharp edge of a sword, or any cutting instrument.
2 The tip of the ear.
3 A line, a row or range.
4 A mark, a spot, a stain.
5 A louse.
6 A woman with a beard.
7 A boundary, a limit.
8 A raised bank, a causeway, a bridge.
9 A circumference.
10 Maintenance of a scholar during the period of his studies, by his teacher.
11 Praise, eulogium.
12 The hip or haunch.
13 A Prastha or measure so called.
E.
पाल to nourish, इ aff., and in most cases, ङीष् being optionally added, also पाली: see पाल.

f. (-का)
A lizard.
E.
पल्ली, and कन् added.

f. (-का)
1 The sharp edge of a cutting instrument.
2 A sort of ladle or knife for skimming milk, curds, &c.
3 The lobe of the ear.
E.
पाली as above, with कन् added; see also पालक.

mn. (-लः-लं)
A small pond.
E.
पल to go, Uṇādi aff. वल.

m. (-सः)
A tortoise.
E.
पल्वल a pond, and आवास abode.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what protects, nourishes, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A horse-keeper, a groom.
2 A cherisher, a protector, a guardian.
E.
पाल to nourish, aff. वुन्.

m. (-प्यः)
A name of a Muni or saint, a form of the divine physician DHANVANTARI.

m. (-घ्नः)
A mushroom.
E.
पाल earth, derived from पाल to nourish, and घ्न destructive.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 The olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
2 A sort of beet root, (Beta bengalensis.)
3 A hawk.
f. (-ङ्की)
Incense, the resin of the olibanum; also पालङ्क्या.
E.
पाल nourishing, अङ्क what goes or gives, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.

f. (-ङ्क्या)
Gum olibanum.
E.
पालङ्क the olibanum tree, यत् added.

n. (-नं)
1 Preserving, guarding, protecting, cherishing, nourishing.
2 The milk of a cow that has recently calved.
E.
पाल to nourish, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Protecting, cherishing.
E.
पाल to protect, शतृ aff.

mfn. (ता-त्री-तृ)
Protecting, cherishing, a protector, &c.
E.
पाल to nourish, तृच् aff.

m. (-ण्डः)
A country in India, the western part of Behar.
E.
पलाश belonging to the Palāśa tree, &c. खण्ड district; abounding in the Butea frondosa.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Who or what nourishes or protects.
E.
पाल to protect, णिनि aff.

m. (-न्दः)
A sort of jasmine, (J. pubescens.)
f. (-न्दी)
Teöri; see the next.
E.
पाल to nourish, (the bee,) aff. किन्दच्.

f. (-न्धी)
A plant, commonly Teöri, (Convolvulus turpethum), the black sort.
E.
see the last, aff. किन्धच्.
